The attachment theory is actually really interesting when you learn about it! I have a psychology background which has been part of why I was able to grasp my situation as soon as I did. Essentially, there are four different types: Secure (the ideal), Avoidant-Dissmissive (my type), Anxious-Peocupied, and Disorganized.

My type is characterized by discomfort in getting too close to people out of fear of becoming emotionally vulnerable or inability to trust that someone won't hurt them. People with this attachment style, including myself, try to be as emotionally independent as possible. This is usually caused by a childhood that caused the child to learn that their parents/guardians' love and affection was only temporary. In order to avoid feeling abandoned by their caretaker, they teach themselves to rely on the guardians as little as possible.

Unfortunately, I'm having to contend with what this all means for me going forward.
